name: Superfire | 200mg Gummies | Sour Strawberry
description: The flavor hits fast with a burst of fresh-picked strawberry and a tangy sour twist, making every bite bright, refreshing, and satisfying. Behind the taste is a fast-onset sativa high that promotes alertness, creativity, and feel-good momentum — perfect for daytime activity, social settings, or kicking off your morning with fire.
